messages.subject: GBM design document
parts:
Hello,

I am interested in contributing to this project and wondering if there is a high-level document that describes how GBM works under the hood. Also, which is the best branch to start form? Someone with the user name JHickey has forked the repo and made quite a lot of changes. I'm wondering if that is where I should start or if those changes are independent from the core GBM developers.

Thanks

-Eric

messages.author: 990bd78abe1370d4
messages.subject: Re: GBM design document
parts:
Hi!

James Hickey's changes will be the future of GBM. He's being funded by AstraZeneca[0], who use GBM for mining clinical trial data, to refactor the code to improve extensibility and maintainability.  When the work is finished and we're confident it's correct - and you've seen it's quite extensive - it'll be merged back in. We're also going to add in Terry Therneau's Cox code, which will considerably improve gbm's time to event facilities.

The work lives at

https://github.com/scientific-computing-solutions/gbm

I've held off from merging it into gbm-developers/gbm/master so far because I'd like to get a coherent worthwhile fully tested change that we know works. Any comments on the code are welcome!

There will be a design document produced as part of this, but we don't yet have it.

Hope this helps,

pdm

[0] disclaimer: who I work for...
